candidate.name: Wnt-lowering (tankyrase-type) agents and GSK3 modulation as a downstream lever (TX-004)

context.disease_id: WWOX-deficient human cerebral organoid model (engineered knockout; NOT a patient allele)

p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: No measurement exists in a WWOX system.

cellular_context.limits: The direction is contested: a GSK3 inhibitor pushes Wnt the wrong way if WWOX loss hyper-activates it (DL-MOL-003); 'lower MYC/Wnt is better' is not a safe default.

abstention_card.missing_datum: A dose-by-timing series of Wnt/GSK3/CK1 modulation in a developing cortex with progenitor, layer-neuron and electrographic endpoints, in any WWOX system; and a measured activation step (reporter or nuclear/cytosolic beta-catenin). Never administered in any WWOX system as a Wnt-lowering or tankyrase-type agent, and never as a dose-by-timing series. Two partial exceptions are in the repository: the CK1-alpha-inhibiting multikinase compound of the D01 card was given to knockout organoids (attribution among Wnt, MYC and CDK ambiguous), and a GSK3 inhibitor was given acutely to Wwox-null mice before a convulsant challenge with a seizure endpoint and a measured GSK3 phospho-state in brain (PMID 32000863, repository reading, text re-inspected); neither measures the activation step by reporter or beta-catenin. The transcript direction in organoids is the only Wnt-output measurement.
abstention_card.search_record: NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA as a test (known-roads § 2.4c, 2026-10-20); R3 adjacent query on tankyrase inhibition with neuro and development returned 2 records, one read.
adjacent_context_not_wwox_evidence: an esterified tankyrase-inhibitor prodrug in a Shank3b mouse separated toxicity from benefit by formulation, not by dose, from one dose pair (liver and gut toxicity in juveniles)
a GSK3 inhibitor in adult kainate epilepsy: Wnt activation reduced two of four histological markers in one model (opposite direction, different disease)

embryonic cortical progenitors, genetic and not pharmacological: siRNA knockdown in one study, gene deletion in the other (blind verifier, full text, 2026-11-20): in utero knockdown of either GSK-3 isoform at embryonic day 14.5 in a subset of cells (ICR mice, three brains) raised the proliferating fraction of electroporated cells; GSK3beta knockdown lowered the intermediate-progenitor and upper-layer-neuron fractions while GSK3alpha knockdown raised the intermediate-progenitor fraction and left the upper-layer fraction unchanged, and the authors say off-target effects of the knockdown reagents are not excluded (Ma 2017); conditional deletion of GSK3beta on a germline GSK3alpha-null background in neural progenitors gave progenitor over-proliferation and death at birth, no cause of death stated (Kim 2009) [IT59 2026-11-20 packet change]

evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: The direction is contested: a GSK3 inhibitor pushes Wnt the wrong way if WWOX loss hyper-activates it (DL-MOL-003); 'lower MYC/Wnt is better' is not a safe default.

p4_card.pharmacology: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE, class level (HE ADV-098 batch 9, public databases, 2026-11-20): five non-lithium GSK-3 inhibitors were queried, with beta potencies in vitro from sub-nanomolar to micromolar depending on the document and assay (tideglusib also has bound-only rows above ten and above thirty micromolar; two AR-A014418 beta values above one hundred micromolar, 2011 and 2023, and a 2015 LY2090314 pair of 1.5 and 0.9 micromolar carry database validity flags); a measured alpha-to-beta pair within one document exists only for CHIR99021, LY2090314 and AR-A014418 (SB-216763 has none and tideglusib only bounds), and there alpha is not distinguished from beta or is at most about 2.5-fold weaker (0.8- to 2.5-fold, the low end a pair of LY2090314 mutant-enzyme constructs; the weak 2011 AR-A014418 pair, about 4.7-fold in the other direction, set apart; none shown to separate alpha from beta by an order of magnitude); tideglusib is non-ATP-competitive and time-dependent, so its potency depends on pre-incubation and is not set against the ATP-competitive agents; no ordering of agents is read from these values; no brain or plasma concentration was found for any of the five; selectivity is not assessed; no US label was found for tideglusib; paediatric programmes of tideglusib exist as registry statuses only, results not read [IT59 2026-11-20 packet change].
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for the candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.

p4_card.next_measurement: A GSK-3 substrate-phosphorylation panel in the cortex of the Wwox neuronal-deletion line at postnatal day 17 (tau phospho-sites over total tau, Ser9 over total GSK3beta, beta-catenin), designed with a decision per outcome and no data yet (SCI v2.2 and v3.1; a flat panel excludes ONE proposition only (that GSK-3 beta restraint on tau is released in bulk cortex of the neuronal-deletion line at postnatal day 17, at the tested tau sites, above the margin fixed before data) and does not close the candidate or the class, an elevated panel is the condition under which an inhibitor arm exists; an earlier wording on this card, that a flat panel closes the candidate, is corrected on SCI's v3.1 section 6.10 (the v3 table row 'Panel S-flat: closed for this model and age' is read through it) [IT59 2026-11-20 third packet change]); then an activation-step measurement (reporter, nuclear beta-catenin) in a WWOX-deficient neural system, then the dose-by-timing series [IT59 2026-11-20 packet change].
p4_card.value_added: Names the missing datum so that the axis is a recorded gap and not a silence.
p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven separate queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; the only synonym-driven record is one observational natural-history registry. Carried with the census's own caution: "A missing hit does not prove that no study exists." It answers seven queries against one registry on one date; unregistered, differently worded, non-NLM or later-registered studies are not excluded.

not_known: A dose-by-timing series of Wnt/GSK3/CK1 modulation in a developing cortex with progenitor, layer-neuron and electrographic endpoints, in any WWOX system; and a measured activation step (reporter or nuclear/cytosolic beta-catenin). Never administered in any WWOX system as a Wnt-lowering or tankyrase-type agent, and never as a dose-by-timing series. Two partial exceptions are in the repository: the CK1-alpha-inhibiting multikinase compound of the D01 card was given to knockout organoids (attribution among Wnt, MYC and CDK ambiguous), and a GSK3 inhibitor was given acutely to Wwox-null mice before a convulsant challenge with a seizure endpoint and a measured GSK3 phospho-state in brain (PMID 32000863, repository reading, text re-inspected); neither measures the activation step by reporter or beta-catenin. The transcript direction in organoids is the only Wnt-output measurement.
Whether the activation step, as distinct from the transcriptional output, is increased.

GSK-3 premise status after the 2026-11 comparison work (class level; hypothesis): the GSK-3 and Wnt transcript premise was not supported in the organoid and not distinguishable from random gene sets in the held postnatal day 17 mouse cortex (bulk, three against four animals; the Wnt sign agrees with the premise, inside the null band in the primary run and borderline in the blind recompute), and, among the partners in the held literature, one interactome partner, GSK3beta, meets the registered criteria with narrowings (directness not shown by the assays; the pharmacology of the criterion is partial, lithium at abstract level and no GSK3beta-specific non-lithium constant read in a primary source; the cell readout is a retinoic-acid-differentiated neuroblastoma line; the only tissue datum, lower phospho-Ser9 in Wwox-null brain, is the direction of more active kinase, whereas the cell-line paper reports phospho-Ser9 unchanged and attributes its effect to binding: the sources are in tension on the role of Ser9); no GSK-3 substrate measurement exists in a Wwox-deficient neuron (the cell-line paper reads Tau phospho-sites after WWOX knockdown and overexpression in a neuroblastoma line) [IT59 2026-11-20 packet change].

Brain or plasma concentration of any non-lithium GSK-3 inhibitor, free or total, adult or juvenile: not found in rodents by the database rows read and by PubMed title searches, for five agents (tideglusib, SB-216763, CHIR-99021, LY2090314, AR-A014418); selectivity was not assessed [IT59 2026-11-20 packet change].

Whether any organoid transcript difference or null on this card (deposit GSE156243) is independent of the CRISPR clone and of the batch: the sequenced knockout organoids are four of ONE clone (1B, from edit-spanning reads, ADV-244, SCI, 2026-11-25), the other clone (A2) was not sequenced, the comparator is two organoids of the parental line (the authors removed two of four wild-type libraries, one for failed quality control and one for not clustering), and the organoids appear to come from one batch (the authors' Methods: organoids from the same batch were used for all analyses unless stated otherwise; their reply to reviewers speaks of the batch of the RNA-seq; not stated as a measured fact for these six libraries), so a difference here is not shown to be a property of the knockout rather than of the clone or the batch. [IT 2026-11-25, ADV-244]

card_conventions: IPOTESI throughout; the bridge forces it. No score, rank, probability or blended index is carried, and none may be derived from this card.

directional_summary compares signs only where target, endpoint and every context dimension match; UNRESOLVED means no matched comparison exists, which is a statement about the record, not about the biology.
NO_MATCH_FOUND is not 'does not exist'; NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA is not MAI_TENTATO.
label_lookup is NOT_ATTEMPTED on every card: the bridge has no network and no pharmacological-label search was run. It is not NO_MATCH_FOUND.
No dose, route, schedule or paediatric suitability appears; concentrations or exposures of the sources are deliberately not reproduced.
Every adjacent source is labelled NOT WWOX EVIDENCE at class level.
no_new_reading: No paper was opened for this card; the sources are the repository's own receipted notes and records.
